{{Quote|They were in the wrong place at the wrong time. Naturally, they became heroes.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="ANH novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''Alliance to Restore the Republic''', also known as the '''Alliance to Restore Freedom to the Galaxy''', the '''Rebel Alliance''', or informally as the '''Rebellion''', was a loose [[Alliance (disambiguation)|alliance]] of [[Planet/Legends|planetary]], [[Star system/Legends|system]], and [[Sector/Legends|sector]]-level insurrectionist [[Organization|factions]]. They were generally united in common cause, against a common enemy in the form of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In order to achieve their primary goal in restoring the former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Alliance aimed to remove [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] from power, and his hegemonic [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Members of the Rebellion were known as "Rebels," "Rebs," or "Rebel scum" by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and other Imperials.

The origins of the overall anti-[[Imperialization/Legends|Imperial]] movement dated back to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], shortly before the Galactic Republic's [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] into the Empire. Some of the Alliance's core founders, such as [[Senator/Legends|senators]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]], joined the [[Delegation of 2000]] in its opposition against the authoritarian leadership of then-[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] Palpatine. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], barely a year into the Empire's existence, military resistance had already been formed in opposition to the new regime; one of which was a group of insurgents known as [[The Eleven]], joined by the [[Order 66/Legends|fugitive]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ferus Olin]]. By [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Alderaanian Resistance|several]] [[Chandrilan resistance|resistance]] [[Corellian Resistance/Legends|groups]] were [[Corellian Treaty|unified]] into a single rebellion, thus creating the Rebel Alliance. Ironically, the Rebel Alliance's formation was secretly instigated by the [[Order of the Sith Lords]]. In what was supposed to be a plot for drawing the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] enemies out from hiding, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]], [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], to organize various rebels and dissidents into a large resistance movement. After Starkiller was betrayed by his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], however, the former apprentice [[Battle on Death Star I|sacrificed himself]] to ensure the survival of the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Rebel leaders]].

Hence, the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] erupted with the fledgling Alliance challenging the Empire for control of the galaxy. Rather than challenging the Empire directly, the rebels fought a war of attrition, destroying key Imperial targets and liberating numerous worlds. Though vastly outnumbered in [[Trooper/Legends|manpower]], [[Starship/Legends|starships]], weapons and various other resources, the Rebels themselves possessed a strong will to fight. By and large, the Alliance was composed of well-trained [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and brilliant [[Commander/Legends|commanders]], some of whom dedicated their lives to the Rebellion after defecting from the Empire due to the atrocities that were committed by the Imperial regime. After securing early victories against the Empire on [[Assault on Kamino|Kamino]] and [[Battle of Toprawa|Toprawa]], the Rebels achieved one of their most significant triumphs at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], in which a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] named [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] destroyed the Imperial battlestation code-named [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], roughly four years [[Galactic Standard Calendar|after]] the [[0 BBY/Legends|destruction]] of the first Death Star, Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader both [[Death/Legends|perished]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

In the wake of their victory at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the Rebel Alliance established the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] as a interim civilian administration while the Rebel Alliance reorganization into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Ultimately, the New Republic was later remade into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], a more autocratic union that united much of the galaxy under a [[Galactic Alliance Senate|republican form of government]], just as the Galactic Republic had [[Galactic Senate/Legends|done]] in its time, though such a system ultimately could not withstand the threats it faced, and like the Republic was laid low by the Sith.

==History==
===Early foundations===
{{Quote|Vote for Palpatine. Vote for the Empire. Make Mon Mothma vote for him too. Be good little Senators. Mind your manners and keep your heads down. And keep doing all those things we can't talk about. All those things I can't know. Promise me, Bail.|Padmé Amidala, to Bail Organa, during the Declaration of a New Order|<ref name="EpisodeIIIn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'' (novel)]]</ref>}}
In the final [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], certain [[Senator/Legends|senators]], such as [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="AmidalaDB">{{DB|character|amidala|Amidala, Padmé}}</ref> [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="OrganaDB">{{DB|character|bailorgana|Organa, Bail}}</ref> and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]<ref name="MothmaDB" /> grew increasingly concerned over the constitutional amendments that weakened the legislature and empowered the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|executive branch]] with near [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|dictatorial authority]].<ref name="EpisodeIIIn" /> Although a majority of the Senate supported such alterations to the government's overall structure because of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and subsequent [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], both of which threatened to divide [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in half between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist insurrection]],<ref name="EpisodeII">{{Film|II}}</ref>

[[File:Sithdelscener1pic2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A group of Republic loyalists discuss their options for opposing Palpatine's policies.]]
The Rebellion against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] began as a peaceful movement by a political minority, known as the [[Delegation of 2000]], within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="EpisodeIIIn" /> the members of the Delegation of 2000 felt that the amendments were too radical, unconstitutional, and generally detrimental to the future of the Republic. Despite the fact that the Separatists were on the verge of defeat in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final year of the Clone Wars, most senators continued to invest even greater authority within [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Fearing that the Republic would inevitably drift into an authoritarian regime, the Delegation of 2000 formally presented their concerns to the Chancellor with the request for the relinquishing of his emergency powers.<ref name="EpisodeIIIn" />

Unknown to the Delegation of 2000, however,<ref name="EpisodeIIIn" /> Chancellor Palpatine was secretly a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious. For a [[1000 BBY/Legends|thousand years]], the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] waited and plotted for the time when they would reassert their dominance over the galaxy, specifically by overthrowing the Galactic Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. As Palpatine, Sidious spent decades infiltrating the political hierarchy of the Republic. His election as chancellor, the creation of the [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone army]], the escalation of the Separatist movement and the outbreak of the Clone Wars were all factors in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Grand Plan/Legends|plot]] to seize control of the galaxy.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

Three years of galactic warfare strengthened Chancellor Palpatine's position as a public figure. Public support for his leadership in the Clone Wars remained strong throughout the conflict; he was immensely popular with the Republic citizenry, and the Senate majority remained firmly committed to its leader in regard to his policy-making decisions. Yet the systematic suppression of thousands of years of Republic traditions and democratic ideals convinced Amidala, Organa, and a group of like-minded senators that the Republic was in danger of losing its core principles for the sake of security. The passing of the [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]] all but made the Senate obsolete; entire [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] would be controlled by a cabal of military [[Governor/Legends|governors]]&mdash;otherwise known as [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]]&mdash;hand-picked by Chancellor Palpatine.<ref name="EpisodeIIIn" />

Thus, the Delegation responded with a [[Petition of 2000|petition]] of two thousand signatures from members of the Senate who objected to the Moffs' virtual usurpation of the Senate's responsibilities. They also hoped that their collective opposition would force Chancellor Palpatine to restore the Republic to its pre-war state. The Delegation's cause to prevent further amendments to the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Constitution]] was ultimately lost when Palpatine issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency directive]] that caused the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic clone soldiers]] to [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|betray and murder]] their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|officers]].<ref name="EpisodeIIIn" /> Palpatine then called for a special session of congress, in which he presented a fabricated recollection of a Jedi [[Showdown on Coruscant|assassination attempt]] on his life. The invention of a "Jedi rebellion" presented Palpatine with the justification for his ultimate modification to the Republic; he [[Declaration of a New Order|declared]] himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the first Galactic Empire.<ref name="EpisodeIII">{{Film|III}}</ref> Amidala and Organa, two of the leading members in the Delegation of 2000,<ref name="EpisodeIIIn" /> watched in abject shock as their colleagues cheered the end of democracy with thunderous applause.<ref name="EpisodeIII" />

One of the earliest orders of business for the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[New Order/Legends|new regime]] was the targeting of the Delegation of 2000. Charged with [[Sedition (crime)|sedition]] and [[Treason/Legends|high treason]], many who had signed the petition in opposition to Palpatine's policies were imprisoned, executed or forced into exile. After the Empire [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|conquered and razed]] the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], many more members of the Delegation withdrew their support out of fear for their lives. However, Organa and Mothma were both able to avoid persecution for a time.<ref name="RiseOfVader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> Prior to Amidala's [[Death/Legends|death]], the Naboo senator advised her political allies to oppose the Emperor in secret while feigning obedience.<ref name="EpisodeIIIn" />

===Armed resistance===
{{Quote|The Empire maintains order, and people like you disrupt that order.|[[Sarkli]]|<ref name="Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Snipermakeshistargetr.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The assassination of Queen Apailana brought an end to Naboo's nascent rebellion against the Empire.]]
Emperor Palpatine's strategy for the enforcement of the New Order was based on brutal tactics, such as the implementation of the fear of [[Imperial Military/Legends|military force]] in order to discourage ideas of insurrection. The rise of the Galactic Empire was not supported by all member worlds. One of the first [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that attempted to resist [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialization]] was the Emperor's own homeworld of Naboo, ruled by [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]] at the time.<ref name="SWBII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> Under Apailana's leadership, [[Naboo (people)/Legends|the Naboo]] continued to celebrate the memory of the Republic, rather than acknowledging the Empire's rule over the galaxy.<ref name="ApailanaDB">{{DB|character|queenapailana|Apailana, Queen}}</ref> The Queen also began considering military options that involved sheltering Jedi fugitives. Such actions were discovered and interpreted as signs of rebellion by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], and thus the Empire retaliated with the deployment of armed forces to Naboo. The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], an [[Special forces/Legends|elite]] [[Division/Legends|division]] of [[Clone stormtrooper|clone]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] under the command of the Sith Lord [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Battle of Naboo (Imperial Period)|assaulted]] the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. Although the Queen's [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|security detail]] was augmented by the Jedi, they were ultimately unable to repel the 501st. The city fell to the Imperials, its [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] was destroyed, and Apailana was assassinated during the battle. In the following years, the Empire repeatedly overthrew disloyal governments through force, often relying on Vader's 501st Legion for enforcing the Emperor's rule where ever it was opposed.<ref name="SWBII" />

In the same year, a group of disillusioned civilians publicly protested against the Empire's despotic policies, including its high taxation of [[Ghorman/Legends|Ghorman]]. They staged their protest on the landing platform where Moff [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was set to arrive. Their attempt to block Tarkin's arrival did not succeed; in what became known as the [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]], the Governor simply landed his vessel on the platform, killing hundreds of activists in the process. This event was interpreted as a tragedy by outraged sympathizers who also disagreed with the direction of the Empire. [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] and other [[Imperial officer/Legends|career officers]] whose service records [[Republic officer/Legends|dated back]] to the Republic either resigned or retired from Imperial service. The incident also convinced Bail Organa that the Empire was a malevolent government. Yet with so many disorganized and uncoordinated rebel cells, Organa remained convinced that the time was not right for open rebellion.<ref name="RAS" /> He continued to [[Cantham House Meetings|meet in secret]] with his closest political allies, senators Mon Mothma and [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in the [[Cantham House/Legends|Cantham House]] on Coruscant in order to discuss options for creating their own rebellion against Palpatine. Mothma, however, was forced to [[Mon Mothma's escape from Coruscant|flee]] into exile after being labeled a traitor to the Empire due to her outspoken criticism of the New Order.<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Iblis's failure to hide his own discontent with the Empire also [[Bombing of the Treitamma Political Center|drove]] him underground in order to escape persecution.<ref name="TFUdb" />

[[File:Kaminouprising.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Imperial 501st puts down the clone rebellion on Kamino.]]
Further incidents of armed resistance against Imperial rule involved [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|remnants]] of the fallen Separatist movement. [[Gizor Dellso]], a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] war criminal who survived the Clone Wars, fled into hiding on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Utilizing an abandoned [[Techno Union droid factory/Legends|droid factory]], Dellso constructed his own [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|private army]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] for the sole purpose of reviving the Separatist cause. Before his plot could be carried out, the 501st Legion [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|attacked]] Mustafar and destroyed his army; Dellso died during the fighting shortly before his factory was destroyed by [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]] via [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]].<ref name="SWBII" />

Another insurrectionist plot against the Galactic Empire was later discovered on Kamino, the world that was responsible for the creation of the Republic clone army. A [[Kaminoan resistance|rogue group]] of [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Clone Master/Legends|cloners]] resented the Empire's control of their homeworld. Throughout the first decade of the Empire, they secretly engineered and trained an [[Anti-trooper|army of rebel clone troopers]], all of whom were programmed with absolute loyalty to Kamino.<ref name="KaminoDB">{{DB|location|kamino|Kamino}}</ref> After Darth Vader uncovered the scheme, he dispatched the 501st&mdash;under the leadership of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]&mdash;to the planet. The [[Kamino uprising|subsequent battle]] resulted in the destruction of the rogue clones and their creators, as well as the fall of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] and all of Kamino. The incident was classified and kept hidden from public records, but Palpatine decided that an army of clones from one [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] was too susceptible to corruption. Hence, both the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] were heavily diversified with the introduction of new clone [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who were based on a variety of different templates.<ref name="SWBII" /> The Empire later redirected the clone program to pursue other projects, and thus the military was compensated with an increase in the recruitment of birth-born [[Human/Legends|Humans]] as enlisted [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]].<ref name="TFUIIdb">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>

===Darth Vader's secret apprentice===
{{Quote|The historical records will claim that the Rebel Alliance was born on Corellia. That is a documented fact, but the truth is this: the Rebel Alliance was born in the Scarl system&hellip; aboard Darth Vader`s personal starship, the ''Executor''.|[[PROXY]]|<ref name="TFUc">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' graphic novel]]</ref>}}
[[File:WhereShouldIStart.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Vader orders his secret apprentice to forge a rebellion against the Empire.]]
Years before the formation of the Rebel Alliance, Darth Vader discovered a young Human child named [[Galen Marek]] during an [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|attack on Kashyyyk]].<ref name="TFUn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref> Marek's father and mother, [[Kento Marek|Kento]] and [[Mallie Marek]], were both [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] members of the Jedi Order.<ref name="TFUIIn" /> Thus, he possessed an incredibly [[Force-sensitive/Legends|powerful connection]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Realizing the boy's potential was too great to discard, Vader abducted Marek and [[Sith training|indoctrinated]] him into the ways of the Sith as a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]]. As time passed, Marek developed into a highly efficient [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]], known only to a select few by the codename Starkiller;<ref name="TFUdb" /> his past and former identity were ultimately forgotten as he had been too young to remember what his life was like before falling under Vader's relentless tutelage.<ref name="TFUn" /> As his training neared completion, Starkiller was all but a true Sith. Under the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], however, only two Sith Lords were allowed to exist.<ref name="ROT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> Starkiller's Master still answered to another Master, the Galactic Emperor. Ultimately, Vader assured Starkiller that they would eventually unite their [[Force power/Legends|powers]] to overthrow Palpatine in order to rule the galaxy as master and apprentice.<ref name="TFUvg" />

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="TFUc" /> Darth Vader commanded Starkiller to search the galaxy for various rebels and dissidents who opposed the Galactic Empire. He was then required to unite them into a single rebellion that would plunge the Empire into a state of civil war. Vader reasoned that an insurrection created the best opportunity to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the Emperor, especially because his attention would be focused primarily on destroying the rebels. Hence, the apprentice embarked on his mission in earnest, and eventually brought [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], the only known survivor from Marek's missions to exterminate any Jedi who survived Order 66, and Bail Organa into the fold after earning their trust. Through Organa, Starkiller also made contact with the fugitives Mon Mothma and Garm Bel Iblis. Organa's adopted daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] also pledged her support to the nascent rebellion while still serving as her father's successor in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].<ref name="TFUvg" />

====Birth of the Rebellion====
{{Quote|We agree that the time for diplomacy and politics has passed. It is now time for action&hellip; therefore let this be an official declaration of rebellion! Today, we all vow to change the galaxy, and one day the galaxy will indeed be free!|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
[[File:PalpatineFoundsTheRebellion-TFU.png|thumb|left|250px|The Rebel Alliance is formed by Starkiller and his allies on Corellia.]]
Starkiller's fellow subversives were initially resistant to the notion of open rebellion. They felt that the galaxy had to be shown one way or another that the Empire was vulnerable. In accordance with Darth Vader's counsel, Starkiller [[Second mission to Raxus Prime|destroyed]] an Imperial [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] that orbited [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. As a single [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] moved to intercept him, the apprentice used the Force to rip the massive vessel from the sky, causing it to crash on the surface below. The symbolic victory had the desired effect as Vader predicted. Starkiller and the senators rendezvoused on Corellia where they [[Corellian Treaty|ceremoniously proclaimed]] the birth of the Rebellion, as well as their intentions to restore liberty to the galaxy.<ref name="TFUvg" />

However, Starkiller had been betrayed by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. The true purpose of his mission was to gather the Emperor's enemies in a single location so that Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]] could arrest them all at once. Darth Vader revealed the truth to his shocked apprentice: he never intended to overthrow the Emperor with Starkiller at his side. After leaving his former assassin for dead, Vader transported the Rebel leaders to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|incomplete Death Star]] where Emperor Palpatine awaited their arrival.<ref name="TFUvg" /> Yet Starkiller survived and ultimately renounced his Sith persona, thus resuming the use of his birth name "Galen Marek," recovered from repressed memories of his past.<ref name="TFUn" />

Marek [[Battle on Death Star I|infiltrated]] the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] and single-handedly slew countless Imperial soldiers before defeating his former Master in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. With Darth Vader severely damaged and at the apprentice's mercy, Emperor Palpatine urged Marek to assume the mantle of a true Sith Lord by killing Vader in cold blood. Though briefly tempted to pursue his lifelong goal once more, Marek chose to rescue the Rebel leaders by attacking the Emperor. The Rebels escaped with their lives, but Marek was forced to sacrifice his own in order to provide them with enough time to flee the Death Star in the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]''.<ref name="TFUvg" />

In the aftermath of Galen Marek's demise, the Rebel leaders reconvened on Kashyyyk where they held a meeting in their fallen leader's [[Kento Marek's hut|childhood home]]. The Alliance to Restore the Republic was officially realized. At Leia Organa's behest, the Rebels chose to honor the secret apprentice's memory by basing their organization's emblem on the [[House of Marek|Marek family]] [[Alliance Starbird|crest]], effectively turning it into a symbol of hope that many beings rallied around during the subsequent [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TFUvg" />

===New allies and weapons===
{{Quote|Time to retire those Z-95 Headhunters!|[[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]], after [[Battle of Fresia|the victory]] at [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]]|<ref name="Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>}}
The most notable equipment contributions included the defection of some [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] staff and all relevant material involved in the development of an advanced starfighter, the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing]], which was acquired at the [[Battle of Fresia]]. With this advanced fighter, Rebel pilots had a clear advantage over the more numerous yet unshielded [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. With the help of [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], who had recently been freed by Rebel forces from slavery under the Empire, Mon Mothma then secured an alliance with the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], who openly joined the Rebel Alliance and used their renowned skill in ship construction to supply badly needed [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] that could take on the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Their considerable fleet of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] gave the newly formed Alliance substantial firepower. Part of the Alliance's strategy was the doctrine of [[space denial]]. That is, the Alliance would attack Imperial shipping in hit and run raids; both to disrupt Imperial supplies and operations, and to confiscate desperately needed materials. In these situations, their fighters had hyperdrive capability along prearranged routes which would allow this kind of harassment and escape before the Empire could react.

At the same time, the Rebel Alliance annexed most of the remaining [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]]. Some remaining Confederate materiel, such as [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|Recusant-class light destroyers]], ended up in Rebel hands.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

Largely because of their fighting against the Empire, [[High General]] [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]] stated in the history of the Imperial Army in the official field manual for the Imperial Military, ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', that the Rebels, and by extension those who claimed kinship with them, feared order, distrusted prosperity, and hated progress.<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

===Destruction of Alderaan===
[[File:RebelPoster.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Rebel [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] efforts after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]]]
{{Quote|Continue with the operation; you may fire when ready.|[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], giving the order to destroy Alderaan|<ref name="EpisodeIV" />}}
Because several key Alliance figures were held prisoner on it after the signing of the Corellian Treaty, the Alliance learned of the construction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], an enormous terror weapon capable of destroying an entire planet, intended to secure the Empire's power. An [[Operation Skyhook|operation]] headed by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] was successful in retrieving the schematics of the station, but [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] discovered the act and captured Leia. In an effort to get the young princess to divulge the location of the secret Rebel base, Grand Moff Tarkin threatened to destroy her home planet of Alderaan. Yet even after Leia gave him the location of an abandoned Rebel base on Dantooine, Tarkin ordered the Death Star to fire its primary weapon&mdash;a planet-destroying superlaser. Leia watched as billions of her fellow Alderaanians [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|were murdered]] by the vicious super-weapon. The Alliance would use this act as a [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] tool to recruit more people into its ranks.<ref name="EpisodeIV" />

===A New Hope===
{{Quote|Remember, the Force will be with you. Always.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="EpisodeIV" />}}
The Force was with the Alliance. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a young man from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], came under the tutelage of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], after stormtroopers destroyed his [[Lars homestead/Legends|farm]] and killed his [[Owen Lars/Legends|uncle]] and [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|aunt]]. The aged Jedi had been watching Luke for a long time. Knowing his family history and importance to defeating the Emperor, Obi-Wan began training the boy as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The duo, along with the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], secured passage on a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]], [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. With the help of smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] co-pilot [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], the group managed to free Princess Leia Organa from the Death Star (only after Obi-Wan sacrificed himself in a duel with Vader) and deliver the plans to the Alliance. As a result, the Alliance succeeded in attacking and destroying the battle station, and also, in Luke, they gained their only loyal member with training in the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and the skills of the practically extinct [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knights.<ref name="EpisodeIV" />

===Galactic Civil War===
[[File:DeathStar_plans.png|thumb|right|250px|Rebel pilots before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|attack]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|First Death Star]]]]
{{Quote|In the past, we'd secretly enjoyed putting down a local insurrection or two, they kept the troops sharp and the Empire feared; but these Rebels were different. They were organized, they were growing, and they were everywhere.|Journal of the 501st|<ref name="SWBII" />}}
As a result of the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Alliance gained credibility as a legitimate military opponent to the Empire. Between the effects of the battle and the dissolution of the Imperial Senate, thousands of star systems openly joined the Alliance in the months following the Death Star's destruction.<ref name="VQ">''[[Star Wars: Vader's Quest]]''</ref> As a result, the Empire began occupying worlds it had allowed to remain untouched earlier, both actions resulting in an escalation of the war.

The Alliance could afford to waste no time following its major victory at Yavin. Following numerous [[Evacuation of Yavin|raids]] on their [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] [[Great Temple/Legends|base]], the Alliance relocated temporarily to a [[Thila Command|base]] on [[Thila/Legends|Thila]] while setting up a more permanent establishment on the ice planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. There were some setbacks, namely [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] leaving the Alliance following a major disagreement with Mon Mothma to create his own [[Garm Bel Iblis's movement|rebellion]]. This was a blow to the Alliance, though it was offset by the joining of [[Borsk Fey'lya]] and his sizable faction of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]]. Mon Mothma took steps to create a true navy for the Alliance, raising the Mon Calamari Gial Ackbar to the rank of Admiral and appointing him [[Supreme Allied Commanders|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]]. Under Ackbar's leadership the fleet grew in size and ability. Along with the headquarters of the Rebel Alliance, Ackbar's fleet was the most important asset of the Rebellion. During this time Luke, Han, Leia, and their companions proved to be the most valuable Alliance members, performing countless crucial missions.

The ensuing battles around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were a number of engagements between either side. Many were Rebel soldiers fighting to sabotage Imperial weapons or destroy Imperial facilities. A large number of people were inspired by the defeats of the Galactic Empire to join the Rebellion. However, the might and oppressive nature of the Empire inspired others to join the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].

====Loss of Hoth====
[[File:Rebel_pilot_memorial.jpg|thumb|left|210px|A holo memorial honored Rebel pilots who were killed during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].]]
{{Quote|Imperial troops have entered the base! Imperial troops have-|[[Jobin]]|<ref name="EpisodeV" />}}
The Alliance suffered a [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|setback]] when [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command's]] main base of operations on the ice planet Hoth, was discovered by an [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Imperial probe droid]] and overrun by Darth Vader's forces. In the ensuing battle to escape, the Rebels used their large ground-based ion cannon to disable several of the Star Destroyers in orbit, effectively punching temporary holes in the Imperial blockade long enough for Rebel [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree]] transports and other craft to escape the planet. The Alliance was forced to scatter and remain mobile until the end of the war for fear of losing another main base. Therefore the High Command was transferred to the Rebel Fleet, using Ackbar's flagship [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] as their mobile base of operations. This was a dark time for the Alliance with the loss of men and equipment on Hoth as well as being forced into hiding from the Empire. Also, Rebel hero Han Solo was captured while in [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] hospitality on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], subsequently frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], and sent to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] on Tatooine by the bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Furthermore, the secret shipyards in the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]] were destroyed by Darth Vader's fleet.<ref name="EpisodeV" />

====Crucial Victory at Endor====
[[File:Battle_over_Endor.png|thumb|right|250px|The new [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] served as the backdrop for the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].]]
News that a new and more powerful Imperial space station, [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]], was nearing completion, forced the Alliance to take its greatest risk. The entire Rebel Fleet was amassed near [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], in order to launch an attack on the installation before it could become operational. Most important to the decision to initiate this attack was the knowledge that the Emperor himself was overseeing the final stages of construction on board the Death Star. However, in secret, the Empire had organized its forces there so that when the Rebel fleet was lured in, it would be destroyed. The plan backfired, and the subsequent [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] was a massive victory for the Alliance. Palpatine was dead; his Death Star destroyed, along with many Imperial warships, including Darth Vader's flagship,
''The Executor.'' Darth Vader, who was redeemed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], his son, became [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] once again and sacrificed himself to kill Palpatine, saving Luke in the process.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

===Reorganization into New Republic===
{{Quote|We are no longer the Rebel Alliance. United, we are quite literally, an Alliance of Free Planets. And so shall we remain until the Republic can be restored.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="TAB Sourcebook">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
About one week after the death of the Emperor at Endor, Mon Mothma [[Declaration of the Alliance of Free Planets|declared]] the Rebellion (which became the [[Alliance of Free Planets]]) to be at an end, one month after that, she [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|declared]] the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to be established as the successor state. The Alliance to Restore the Republic had succeeded&mdash;a new Republic was to be born, though in many people's eyes the movement only gained real legitimacy with the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|capture of Coruscant]] [[Mission above Imperial City|twice]] by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and New Republic forces in [[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]].

==Government and politics==
===The Civil Government===
{{Quote|The Alliance was structured to wage war, not rule in peace. It was a benign dictatorship empowered to lead a Rebellion, not govern a galaxy.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="DFR Sourcebook">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
{{Main|Alliance Civil Government/Legends}}
The Alliance was divided into the [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Civil Government]] and the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Military]], led by the [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] and the [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]], respectively. Throughout the Galactic Civil War, however, the two positions were occupied by the same person, [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].<ref name="Warfare" /> The Civil Government was responsible for handling the numerous jobs of any planetary civil government&mdash;including protecting the Alliance's peoples, revenue gathering, the maintenance of vital services, and foreign relations and defense. Many of these functions were left to each member world or government of the Alliance.

The [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] was the head of the Alliance. Essentially an elected dictator, the Chief of State had virtually unlimited power over the Alliance. Elections were held every two years, though in practice this was only a formality as [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] had unanimous support amongst the Alliance members. According to the [[Corellian Treaty]], the position of Chief of State "will be abolished when the Emperor is deposed, killed, or resigns his position of power." When this happened, it was the duty of the Advisory Council to assume executive control of the Alliance and convene a [[Constitutional Convention]] to form a new Galactic Republic.<ref name="Warfare" />

Below the Chief of State was the [[Advisory Council (Alliance)|Advisory Council]], which was composed of representatives of seven Allied governments who had given the most lives in battle to defeat the Empire. This council was the primary advisory body to the Chief of State, responsible for approving or dismissing the proposals of the Chief of State. Furthermore, the Advisory Council had the right to dismiss a Chief of State with a two-thirds majority vote, providing a check to the powers of the Chief. During most of the history of the Alliance, worlds like [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], and [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] were members of the Advisory Council, due to their extreme devotion and high losses of life suffered in Alliance service.

The [[Alliance Cabinet/Legends|Alliance Cabinet]] was the body of Ministers through which the Chief of State could maintain and run the Alliance. Each member was selected by Mon Mothma for their devotion, intelligence, and ability to get things done. The Cabinet was composed of six ministries: the [[Finance Ministry|Ministry of Finance]], responsible for overseeing Alliance funds; the [[Ministry of Education (Alliance)|Ministry of Education]], which controlled [[Civil Intelligence|Alliance Civil Intelligence]] and distributed [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]]; the [[Ministry of State (Alliance)|Ministry of State]], which handled relations with other non-member governments; the [[Ministry of Industry (Alliance)|Ministry of Industry]], which controlled all Alliance factories and production; the [[Ministry of Supply]], which maintained supply chain for the Alliance government; and the [[Ministry of War (Alliance)|Ministry of War]], which advised Chief of State on directing Alliance military forces and controlled the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]].

===The Allied Commands===
{{Main|Allied Command}}
The Alliance [[Allied Command]]s were the individual local governments of planets, sectors, organizations, and groups that were members of the Alliance.<ref name="Warfare" /> Each Allied Command varied slightly depending on how each member world was organized, though in practice Allied Commands mimicked the structure of the Alliance government. Allied Commands ranged from member worlds like Mon Calamari or Alderaan to whole sectors like [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis]] or [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis]].

==Alliance Military==
[[File:Rebel_High_General.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Rebel [[High General]].]]
{{Main|Alliance Military/Legends}}
{{Quote|Everyone in the Rebellion is here for a reason. Everyone was affected by the Empire in one way or another. Everyone has a story to tell. Most of them are tragic.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="Lucky">{{Tales|23|Lucky (comic story)}}</ref>}}
The Alliance Military was charged with defeating the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and bringing down the Emperor's reign of terror, a task to which all Rebel military personnel pledged themselves. Its members variously included Republic [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalists]], former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], and Imperial defectors. The Alliance Military's civilian leaders were the [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|Commander-in-Chief]] and the [[Minister of War (Alliance)/Legends|Minister of War]]. Below them was the [[Chief of Staff (Alliance Military)|Chief of Staff]], who worked between the Commander-in-Chief and the seven [[Supreme Allied Commanders]] of [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]. High Command's structure was an odd amalgam reflecting the Rebel military's reliance on the centralized [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], and [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]], local military forces, and clandestine resistance cells.<ref name="Warfare" />

[[Rebel Fleet Command/Legends|Fleet Command]] controlled the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]], with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] as Supreme Commander from [[0 BBY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] answered to [[Starfighter Command (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Starfighter Command]], which was nominally subordinate to Fleet Command, though this was rarely the case in reality as the Alliance came to depend heavily on [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] as its primary combat force in its early years, though from 0 ABY tactical control of starfighters was assigned to fleet elements or the [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]].<ref name="Warfare" />

[[Special Forces Command (Rebel Alliance)|Special Forces Command]] controlled the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]], the most capable soldiers of the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]]. The SpecForces were a flexible backbone for the entire Rebellion, with barracks regiments acting as specialist support elements for the Fleet and Sector Forces, or guarding High Command's main bases, while temporary task forces conducted most fighting missions. The SpecForces were routinely used to buttress the weakness of Sector Forces.<ref name="Warfare" /> [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply]] and the [[Support Services/Legends|Support Services]] handled military procurement, transport, and logistics, while the [[Chief of Intelligence/Legends|Chief of Intelligence]] controlled [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]].

[[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|Sector Command]] oversaw the Alliance's thousands of [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]], whose [[Rebel trooper/Legends|ground forces]] formed the non-[[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] element of the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance Army]]. Sector Command generally granted the Sector Forces great leeway in conducting operations in their sectors. The Sector Forces in principle belonged to the Allied Commands, though High Command claimed supreme military authority over them where necessary. Sector Command would sometimes ask individual Sector Forces to detach ships and troops to the central Alliance Fleet for crucial operations.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Alliance was the main protagonist faction of the [[original trilogy]] of ''Star Wars''. When writing the films, [[George Lucas]] loosely based the Rebel Alliance on the communist guerrilla group [[Wikipedia:Viet Cong|Viet Cong]] during the Vietnam War, and the Galactic Empire primarily on the [[Wikipedia:United States|United States]] at that time, albeit slightly disguised because the Vietnam War was still ongoing when he penned [[The Star Wars rough draft|''The Star Wars'']] in 1973. Such themes were inspired by Lucas' involvement in the creative process of [[Wikipedia:Francis Ford Coppola|Francis Ford Coppola's]] film [[Wikipedia:Apocalypse Now|''Apocalypse Now'']], which was released in 1979.<ref name="New York Post">{{WebCite|url=https://nypost.com/2014/09/21/how-star-wars-was-secretly-george-lucas-protest-of-vietnam|text=How 'Star Wars' was secretly George Lucas' Vietnam protest|author=Smith, Kyle|date=2014-09-21|work=[[Wikipedia:New York Post|New York Post]]|archivedate=20200512050442}}</ref><ref name="Nixonian gangsters">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> When James Cameron pointed out how the Rebels were similar to the [[Wikipedia:Mujahideen|Mujahideen]] and [[Wikipedia:Al Qaeda|Al Qaeda]] in their technically being a terrorist group, Lucas indicated that that had been his exact intention when writing the films, while adding that it was rooted in anti-colonialist thinking.<ref name="AMC">{{YouTube|video=fv9Jq_mCJEo|text=George Lucas on Star Wars Being Anti-Authoritarian &#124; James Cameron's Story of Science Fiction|channel=channel/UCmxURUIJXKnoC7_i1fPhs7Q|name=AMC}}</ref> The Rebellion's tactics bear similarities with Chinese communist revolutionary leader [[Wikipedia:Mao Zedong|Mao Zedong's]] strategy of a [[Wikipedia:People's war|people's war]].<ref name="SWaH">''[[Star Wars and History]]''</ref>

The [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''A New Hope'' novelization]] revealed that the full name of the Rebel Alliance is the Alliance to Restore the Republic.<ref name="ANH novel" />

George Lucas's alternate explanation of the roots of the Rebel Alliance appeared in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, in the episodes "[[A War on Two Fronts]]," "[[Front Runners]]," "[[The Soft War]]," and "[[Tipping Points]]."<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

In part six of his Endnotes to ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', Jason Fry admitted that he deliberately wrote the Separatists' backstory to be very similar to that of the Rebel Alliance in order to show why the Imperials remained loyal to the Empire despite its atrocities.
